‎Dinolingo Kids Learn Languages - Ratings & Reviews - App Store

## Ratings & Reviews

- 4.4 out of 5

3.8K Ratings

- ### Could be better

Jul 30

 123disappointed456 

We’ve been using this to learn Vietnamese in southern dialect (since Duolingo teaches northern). For what you’re paying, it could be a lot better. A lot of the video lessons are hard to understand - it would be really helpful if all of the videos had captions where you can read and listen at the same time it would be way more helpful. The way the videos currently are, my kids and i just kind of zone out waiting for them to finish so we can move on. The songs are NOT songs, it’s just a lady repeating the words to music, there’s no rhyme or rhythm.

Close

- ### Reviews low, but app is great!

11/07/2024

 SJab55 

Been using on computer and just got the app, I was surprised at the reviews and I’m glad I didn’t see them before downloading. I’m actually not a kid, but learning Vietnamese is a struggle to find good apps. Other ones start with such complex topics and don’t build on them well, meanwhile you can’t count to 10. This app has been great, each thing I learn builds into the next lesson just enough to get that constant repetition. The graphics are complained about but they goofy and it keeps me kinda engaged. It’s also repetitive with games after videos, well, this is how we learn. If you don’t need repetition then like some reviews say I’d imagine you’ll be fluent in a week reading each word once, good luck. App is great I think, I need building blocks and when it’s time to grow I can move into something more advanced.

Close

- ### Great for homeschool

06/14/2024

 SRpetrock9510 

I’m using this for my kids ages 3-11 and it’s great, they retain a lot because of the songs and can remember the phrases from the pictures. We have tried a few other language apps but this one has helped even the 3 year old retain what he’s learning. The older ones can go through the lessons on their own and I can see their progress. I sit and do lessons with the 3 and 5 year old and I’m learning a ton! Love the worksheets and flashcards for non-screen time use and learning to write the language also. Can’t beat the price for 5 kids learning a new language. Very useful tool!

Developer Response

Hello, Thank you so much for sharing your wonderful experience with DinoLingo! We're thrilled to hear that your children are benefiting from the language lessons. It's fantastic to know that even your youngest is retaining what he's learning and that the older ones are progressing independently. We're also glad you find the worksheets and flashcards helpful for non-screen time learning.Thank you again for your kind words and support!

Close

- ### GET THIS APP!

01/18/2024

 Mariela Santamaria 

I am 26 years old, I downloaded this app to learn Arabic. It did not disappoint! It’s better than any learning language app I’ve paid for. It’s interactive and you can repeat lessons as many times needed. So far I haven’t found any issues with it and it’s monthly fee is cheap. There’s so many apps that make you pay triple the rate to only open once and then later delete since it’s not as interactive. If you’re reading this review it’s your sign to GET IT! FYI I did read some reviews that stated it doesn’t start with basics BUT if you go through the lessons there is one for ABC’s and 123’s.

Developer Response

Wow, your review just made our day, Mariela! 🌟 We're thrilled to hear that you're loving the app and finding it super helpful for learning Arabic. It's awesome to know that we're standing out in the sea of language apps out there. 🏆We put a lot of love into making it interactive and easy to use, so hearing that it's working for you is the best feedback ever! And thanks for the shoutout about our basics lessons – you're absolutely right, we've got those covered too! 📚✨Keep rocking your Arabic learning journey, and if you ever need anything, we're here for you. Happy learning! 🚀💖

Close
